description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetModel class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API module. It models a timesheet for an employee, including attributes like employee details, status, start and end dates, and implements normalization for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model representing an employee's timesheet with various attributes including employee info, status, and date range, intended for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeTimesheetModel with a Timesheet entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
